key.original: CUDA 13.0.1：排查该主题时，有人声称“所有串行工作都应无条件搬到GPU。”，根据文档这个说法哪里需要纠正？
key.english: CUDA 13.0.1: When investigating this topic, someone claimed that "all serial work should be unconditionally moved to the GPU." According to the documentation, where does this claim need to be corrected?
